'''Anna''' was an individual who lived in [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Anna worked as a cook in [[Daz's Tavern]].<ref name="Child of Light">"[[Child of Light]]"</ref>
